basic_info.description: Situated on a cul-de-sac off the beaten path but still at the very heart of this wonderful city, is 188 Galewood Circle. Just minutes to shopping and dining on West Portal Avenue and Irving Street. Nearby are the Tower Shopping Center for necessities, the Forest Hill Station and the UC Parnassus Campus. About fifteen minutes to the 101 and 280 freeways to points south and east, as well as the vibrant Mission District and Civic Center's performing and visual arts, Glen Park Village and Bart. The spacious three bedroom, two-and-a-half bath home with a large primary suite has custom upgrades galore, including cabinetry and Ann Sacks tile in the kitchen, to stylishly maximize storage space and provide many conveniences. Custom built-ins, a gas fireplace - and even a built-in bar! - in the living room offer ample entertaining, display and storage space. A patio enhanced by a lovely manicured garden with mature flowering trees offers serene outlooks. A nicely finished attic with closets and garage level storage room provide more space for many needs and activities. Custom flooring throughout, including marble baths, epoxy garage floor and more custom details await the next homeowner. All together a superb home, that offers both amenities and a central location for the best city living
